d.ko: Frontier Tale is a cozy adventure farming game that blends extraction-style gameplay with town building. Forge weapons, explore a charming cel-shaded fantasy world, gather rare resources, recruit unique companions, and build your dream frontier from the ground up.
d.en: Frontier Tale is a cozy adventure farming game that blends extraction-style gameplay with town building. Forge weapons, explore a charming cel-shaded fantasy world, gather rare resources, recruit unique companions, and build your dream frontier from the ground up.
d.zh: 《开拓物语》是一款融合了战术撤离与领地建设的冒险种田游戏。锻造独特武器，去探索世界，寻找稀有宝物，在这个治愈赛璐璐动画风格打造的奇幻世界里，与个性十足的伙伴们一同开拓继承自先祖的遗落领地。收集资源，建造村庄，链接羁绊，勤劳致富，亲手创造超酷的顶级家园！
